column1: # THE KOTLIN QUALITY BASELINE (scripts/mobile-quality-report --update writes it; scripts/ci/mobile_quality_ratchet.py
# holds every push touching the Kotlin code to it). Every production Kotlin function, file and clone set past a limit

# raised, lands only in a commit carrying its kind's trailer (CLAUDE.md, "Code quality ratchets").
